load_precision_metric: load the precision evaluation metric from the Hugging Face evaluate library
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the precision metric
compute_precision: compute precision scores from predictions and references using the loaded precision metric
combine_precision_with_other_metrics: combine the precision metric with other metrics for multi-metric evaluation
list_available_evaluation_modules: list all available evaluation modules in the Hugging Face evaluate library
